description: Square oil painting of two adults meeting in a quiet park. Muted cream, dusty rose and olive gray; broad oil brushstrokes and generous negative space.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: refined oil painting artwork for a dating recommendation card, square 1:1 composition, to be displayed at around 330 x 340 pixels.

Create a beautiful, restrained, poetic contemporary oil painting of a chance meeting. The entire artwork should feel sophisticated, quiet and emotionally suggestive. Two clearly adult people, one man and one woman in their late twenties to thirties, are seen at a distance approaching one another naturally in a very simple park. Their figures are small, together occupying only about the central lower quarter of the picture; the subtle angle of their bodies and a paused step suggest interest, recognition, a possible conversation. Keep faces indistinct, no close-up portrait and no dramatic romance pose.

Composition: large, calm expanses of warm cream and muted dusty rose. A few broad shapes suggest an olive-gray lawn and a barely indicated path, with a low, indistinct horizon. Plenty of negative space around and above the two figures. No elaborate scenery. A square crop should retain both figures with generous breathing room.

Medium: unmistakably oil paint on canvas, broad confident opaque brushstrokes, tactile impasto, softly scumbled edges, simplified color masses, subtle tonal variation. Gallery-quality painterly composition rather than commercial clip art. Delicate contrast and calm daylight. Restrained palette of warm cream, muted gray pink, soft olive gray, and a small dark neutral accent in the clothing. The visual story comes from the figures' gestures and the space between them.

Avoid: watercolor, pencil drawing, ink outlines, transparent watercolor washes, photo realism, photographic texture, detailed faces, crowd, buildings, city skyline, dense plants, flowers, busy foliage, decorative clutter, graphic hearts, text, labels, typography, logo, signature, watermark, border or frame. Generate only the finished square painting.
